## Description

Please provide a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature being addressed. Include motivation, context, and specification references where applicable.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Specification compliance enhancement
- [ ] Refactoring / Code cleanup
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and formatting guidelines of this project (`cargo fmt --all -- --check`).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All tests pass locally with `cargo test --workspace`.
- [ ] No new compiler warnings or clippy warnings are introduced.
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules.
